title: Video Editing & Post-Production
description: Transforming your footage with clean edits, balanced colour, clear sound, and titles for your website and social media.
seoDescription: Professional video editing, colour balancing, and audio cleanup for business, event, and promotional videos. Fast turnaround across Cambridge and London.
heroHeading: Great footage is only half the battle. The story happens in the *edit.*
heroLead: Pacing and structure turn raw footage into a compelling narrative. We assemble interviews, multi-camera angles, and contextual cutaways into focused films with custom motion graphics, balanced colour, and broadcast-level audio.
breakdownHeading: Where raw footage becomes *a finished film.*
breakdownBody: Whether working with rushes filmed by our crews or material supplied by your team, we find the core story. We refine dialogue, remove background noise, and grade colour to match your brand across all deliverables.

deliverables.title: Narrative Assembly & Pacing
deliverables.description: Meticulous assembly of primary dialogue, multicam angles, and purposeful B-roll cutaways to create a natural rhythm that holds viewer attention from the first second.

deliverables.title: Branded Motion & On-Screen Graphics
deliverables.description: Clean animated lower-thirds, kinetic typography, slide callouts, and logo idents built to clarify complex information and align strictly with your brand guidelines.

deliverables.title: Master Sound Mix & Multi-Format Delivery
deliverables.description: Dialogue cleanup, noise reduction, loudness mastering, and licensed music mixing, delivered as full-resolution master files alongside vertical 9:16 social cutdowns with burned-in captions.

ctaHeading: Have raw footage you want to bring *to life?*
ctaDescription: Whether you’re planning an upcoming shoot with our team or have raw rushes ready for editorial assembly, tell us about your project and timeline.
